static_readout_proposal_to_check.source: Yan Eq4/8/11 and screened mutual Coulomb kernel
static_readout_proposal_to_check.formula: u_G=exp(-i Q_G.R0)/|Q_G|; U(r)=4pi*C/Omega sum_q wq Re[(j0(|Q|r)u)^dagger (I-epsilon_inv_sym)u]
static_readout_proposal_to_check.singularity: Subtract diagonal kappa_ref^2/(Q^2+kappa_ref^2)*exp[-(Q/width)^2] in the reciprocal sum and add its independent continuum radial integral. Arbitrary positive reference parameters must cancel with converged sampling. No Gamma head set to zero.
